//: CTO V53 — P9 FinOps E4→E5 transition criteria. P9 STAYS at E4 until EVERY condition below is met=true AND a controller signs off. E5 is NOT a technical switch ODG can flip; it requires a real authorised client, real data, real execution and documented client validation. Nothing here authorises prospecting, contracts, spend, push, deploy or VPS access.
title: FinOps / Cloud-Cost audit

e4Evidence.basis: ESTIMATED costs + SIMULATED savings — never OBSERVED or realised

transitionConditions.condition: A real client explicitly authorises an engagement (signed scope agreement by the owner).
Real cloud-cost/billing data is made legally accessible (lawful basis, minimal scope, documented access conditions).
Explicit agreement on the audit perimeter (services/accounts/period in scope and out of scope).
Real execution of the audit parcours on the real data (not synthetic), producing OBSERVED figures via metering.
Measured results: OBSERVED spend and MEASURED (not simulated) savings after an implemented change, with before/after evidence.
Documented client validation: the client confirms, in writing, that the findings and realised results are correct and accepted.
Independent controller review of the whole engagement (ODG retains authority; Claude Code = technical provider only).

acceptanceCriteria: At least one OBSERVED-basis evidence item replaces the SIMULATED savings figure.
Independent evidence digest verifies (O2.verifyEvidence ok) over the real deliverable.
Controller sign-off recorded; owner authorisation recorded.
rejectionCriteria: Any figure presented as realised while basis is ESTIMATED/SIMULATED.
Data accessed without a documented lawful basis or beyond the agreed perimeter.
No independent controller review, or controller withholds sign-off.
Client does not validate the results in writing.
invariant: Until all conditions are met=true, P9 remains E4 and e5Status remains NOT_STARTED. Simulated savings are NEVER presented as real. ODG keeps authority; a controller is mandatory.
nonGoals: No prospecting, no external message, no contract, no spend.
No CRM or parallel system — reuse the nine primitives, P9 guard, O1/O2, existing evidence.
No push, merge, deployment or VPS access.
